title: Technical Product Delivery Manager for SaaS (Remote – Brazil) | Build the future of healthtech.
description:
• Read until the end for full application instructions.
  • Full-time ongoing/long-term contract on international team | Remote (Brazil-based)
  • $5,200–$6,900 USD /month (≈R$26,700–R$35,700 BRL equivalent)
  • Lead cross-functional execution across dev, design, and stakeholders
  • 5+ years in a customer facing SaaS product environment
  • Strong technical knowledge and experience working with development teams
  • Fluent English required — international team, US-based clients.
  • Start ASAP


About the Role

As Product Delivery Manager , you will be responsible for driving the execution of our product roadmap—working closely with engineering, design, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth, structured, and timely delivery. This is a senior hybrid role that combines elements of project management and product coordination. It is well suited to someone with experience in customer facing SaaS environments who thrives in organized, execution-focused roles.


Join the team behind Optimal DX — the trusted lab interpretation and reporting platform used by functional medicine practitioners around the world. We’re on a mission to help practitioners transform patient outcomes through better data, better insights, and better care.


What You'll Do

  • Manage and coordinate the day-to-day product development process
  • Facilitate planning meetings, daily standups, retrospectives, and delivery reviews
  • Translate product ideas into structured, development-ready tasks
  • Draft and refine feature briefs, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Track progress across sprints and proactively identify and resolve delivery issues
  • Maintain task boards and ensure relevant documentation is kept current and clear
  • Communicate with internal stakeholders (e.g., medical experts, support) to clarify priorities and requirements
  • Support the team in staying aligned with product goals and delivering meaningful outcomes


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience in project management within a software team
  • Have 3+ years of experience in product management within a software team
  • Have worked closely with developers and understand the rhythms of SaaS product delivery
  • Are comfortable interfacing with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Possess strong organizational and communication skills
  • Demonstrate the ability to bring clarity and structure to complex product work
  • Are capable of operating independently while keeping the broader team aligned and informed


Preferred Background

Candidates experienced in roles such as:

  • Product or project management within a small or medium sized software company
  • Business analysis, product operations, or implementation roles in SaaS environments
  • Can demonstrate web based software products you've helped build, being used by paying external customers.


Why this Role Matters

We have a capable development team, a clear product vision, and a growing customer base. What we need is a dedicated individual to help us translate vision into execution —ensuring alignment, structure, and progress at every stage of the product lifecycle.


You’ll be joining a remote, collaborative team working across two complementary platforms: a mature diagnostics tool and a new patient engagement product. This role plays a key part in unifying delivery and maintaining momentum as we continue to scale.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


In addition to your application on Linked In, send a cover-letter to apply @ optive.health, answering the following:

  • Briefly describe why you're interested in this role and why you believe you're a good fit (max 200 words)
  • Describe your experience working with SaaS development teams.
  • List up up to 5 customer facing SaaS applications that you've contributed to. Include screenshots of the application if permissible, and links to direct pages on a website where the application is promoted.
  • Complete the English assessment here and include the results, after taking the assessment only once and without using an external tool for support (like ai or google search):
  • Describe your experience working with English speaking international teams.

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant – International Projects, Remote (Brazil Based)
description:
Are you a talented recruitment professional with a flair for business development and client management? Do you thrive working autonomously while being part of a dynamic international team? If yes, this is your chance to join Remote People and make a global impact!


Remote People is a leading international recruitment agency connecting top talent with forward-thinking companies worldwide. With operations in over 150 countries, we specialize in building world-class teams across industries and regions, offering tailored, compliant solutions that empower businesses to grow and innovate globally.


What You'll Do:


  • Own and nurture client relationships, primarily with US-based clients focusing on recruitment projects in the Americas region.
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment projects: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating placements of top talent.
  • Drive new business opportunities by collaborating with the US sales team, pitching tailored recruitment solutions, and expanding our market presence.
  • Collaborate with LATAM recruitment teams to ensure seamless delivery and client satisfaction across regions.
  • Provide strategic advice to clients on talent market trends, salary benchmarks, and recruitment best practices.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 4+ years of recruitment or consulting experience, ideally in an agency setting.
  • Strong business development skills with a proven track record in client management.
  • Deep knowledge of the LATAM talent landscape, labor laws, and cultural nuances.
  • Fluent in both English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Self-starter mindset: comfortable working independently with autonomy and delivering results.


Why Work With Us?


  • 100% remote work with flexible hours—work from anywhere in Brazil!
  • Be part of a fast-growing, innovative international team focused on results and meaningful impact.
  • Opportunities to work on exciting, high-profile projects across multiple global regions.
  • Competitive compensation and access to the latest recruitment tools.
  • An inclusive culture that values your ideas and fosters your professional growth.


Ready to take the next step in your recruitment career with a global leader? Apply now and join Remote People to help shape the future of talent in the Americas and beyond!

title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Administrador de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Customização e evolução da ferramenta de glossário de termos, alinhando a conceitos de domínios e capacidades do framework BIAN,

Desenvolver e aplicar regras na ferramenta de pré validação de modelos de dados utilizando Regex em C#,

Apoiar o time de Governança de Dados na adoção dos padrões BIAN,

Administrar e modelar dados (conceitual, lógica e física),

Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados,

Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, analistas e equipes de desenvolvimento.


Habilidades e Requisitos


Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados,

Conhecimento prático em automação processos e ferramentas de IA

Conhecimento na esteira CI/CD,

Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem como Erwin ou similares,

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL,

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas,

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. Procuramos SAP Basis – Senior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Temos alguns requisitos:


  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Experiência comprovada em administração do SAP Basis, incluindo experiência em procedimentos padrão SAP, como cópias de clientes, atualizações de bancos de dados, aplicação de patches, gerenciamento de transporte, atualizações e ajuste de desempenho de bancos de dados e aplicativos SAP.
  • Manter o SAP ERP, SAP BW, SAP Bobj e SAP Solution Manager. Paisagens
  • Fornecer suporte para Recuperação de Desastres e testes de DR, conforme necessário.
  • Fornecer suporte diário à equipe de suporte de produção e aos Usuários Finais com qualquer problema técnico e de desempenho.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Fornecer ajuste de desempenho, análise de problemas, atualizações e administração de sistemas para bancos de dados Oracle e instâncias SAP, NetWeaver 2004 e ECC 6.0, BI, PI, SRM, Portal e SAP Hana.
  • Realizar instalação e configuração do Solution Manager para monitorar e administrar os sistemas SAP.
  • Trabalhar com a SAP via OSS e Solution Manager para resolução técnica de problemas. Configurar perfis de inicialização, padrão e de instância.
  • Gerenciar projetos relacionados a atualizações de SAP, DB2 e outras instalações de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento em administração de sistemas SAP combinados, como ECC, Solution Manager, TREX, Content Server, Portal, LVM e HP Quality Center é desejável.
  • Instalar, configurar, manter e oferecer suporte a sistemas SAP, incluindo, entre outros, Solution Manager, ECC, BI, GRC e CRM.

title: Senior Front End engineer
description:
About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


What will you do:

  • Develop a revolutionary system for qualifying autonomous vehicles, and be involved in changing the world…
  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and development teams to create elegant, usable, responsive, and interactive interfaces
  • Be part of the applications group and have a major role in building the web infrastructure of Foretellix products
  • Take full ownership of front end projects from design and architecture to implementation
  • Build reusable code and libraries for future use
  • Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs


Requirements:

***Please send your CV in English

  • At least 6 years of experience developing large-scale, production-grade web front-end systems using JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • B.Sc. in Computer-Science /-Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Deep knowledge of and proven experience with the React.js framework and its ecosystem.
  • Capable of working independently and managing requirements from multiple stakeholders
  • Self-learner, highly motivated, and self-paced
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.


Advantages:

  • Experience with developing complex business logic at an enterprise scale
  • Experience with Redux
  • Knowledge and skills in user experience (UX) design
  • Experience with visualization libraries such as DeckGL, Chart.js

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack JR
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora júnior para atuar no desenvolvimento de software com acompanhamento de profissionais experientes. Foco em aprendizado prático, execução de tarefas e entrega com qualidade, seguindo padrões e boas práticas da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar partes específicas do código sob supervisão, seguindo padrões técnicos e boas práticas.
  • Corrigir bugs e desenvolver pequenas melhorias e funcionalidades.
  • Participar das cerimônias do time (Refinamento, Daily, Review e Retrospectiva).
  • Manter tarefas e histórico atualizados nas ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Documentar o que foi desenvolvido e decisões técnicas relevantes.
  • Realizar e apoiar testes com orientação do time, garantindo a qualidade das entregas.
  • Buscar aprendizado contínuo e evoluir a partir de feedbacks.


Requisitos e competências:

  • Fundamentos de programação e noções dos frameworks e ferramentas do projeto.
  • Capacidade de seguir instruções, processos e diretrizes técnicas.
  • Proatividade para pedir ajuda, tirar dúvidas e aprender com feedbacks.
  • Colaboração, comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em NET Core (C#)
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em Angular
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em GitLab
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em SQL Server
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em Cypress para testes automatizados


Diferenciais:

  • Mobile: experiência com Flutter ou interesse comprovado em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Cloud: noções de Google Cloud (deploy, serviços gerenciados, CI/CD).
  • Segurança: familiaridade com SAST/DAST, boas práticas de AppSec e OWASP Top 10.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Murex BAU Consultant
description:
Project Description

BAU Support - 1st and 2nd level production system support on Murex 3.1


Responsibilities

• Work on a variety of Murex system implementation, configuration and developments in various aspects of Murex including datamart, MXML pre-trade and post-trade workflows, RTBS and MDCS

• Coordinate and communicate with business and IT stakeholders to gather, document and verify requirements

• Analyse and make recommendations based on related Murex implementation experience

• Follow client SDLC lifecycle and documentation requirements

• Support IT and business audits and technology risk assessments

• Development and testing of database and infrastructure changes

• Perform technical reviews of production changes

• Write clear and concise documentation of issues and resolution within confluence

• Maintain and enhance the Control-M scheduling tool for intraday and end of day batches

• Deal directly with business users across the bank including front, middle and back office, finance, product control and risk to analyse and diagnose business critical issues

• Analyse and resolve issues related to risk, pricing, PnL, market data, market operations, EOD, interfaces, reporting

• Provides detailed information about issues to the vendor, and co-ordinates with them in testing fixes / solutions

• Acts as an intermediary between business and vendor

• Debug and enhance bespoke java processes supporting the Murex implementation


Qualifications

Minimum 2 years experience with Murex in a support capacity

Strong technical capability

Solid understanding of datamart

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of  AI
description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work . Please read the recruitment requirements carefully and fill out the application form accurately. Thank you.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 3 paper in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past two years
  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design and maintain scalable data pipelines on AWS, ensuring performance, quality, and security. You will collaborate with data scientists and analysts to integrate data from multiple sources and support AI/ML initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Build and optimize ETL pipelines with AWS Glue.
  • Work with AWS S3, Glue, and SageMaker for data and AI workflows.
  • Develop solutions in Python and SQL .
  • Integrate data from Salesforce and APIs .
  • Ensure data governance, documentation, and best practices.


Tech Stack:


  • AWS (S3, Glue, SageMaker)
  • Python, SQL
  • Salesforce, APIs


Requirements:


  • Proven experience in data engineering with AWS .
  • Strong Python + SQL skills.
  • Experience with ETL, data modeling, and pipeline optimization.
  • Advanced English (international collaboration).

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Generalista - Junior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Organizar e desenvolver o conteúdo dos Workshops específicos das Diretorias atendidas, junto com a BP responsável e demais líderes, diante demanda;
  • Suportar na organização e definição das ações customizadas de engajamento e cultura para as Diretorias atendidas, conforme direcionamento da área de Cultura e/ou necessidade/demanda dos clientes;
  • Suportar os BP’s nas ações customizadas por Diretoria;
  • Atuar como parceiro da Comunicação Interna no papel de “comunicador” para as Diretorias atendidas;
  • Suportar a viabilização e organização dos treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais programados e ou por demanda das Diretorias atendidas;
  • Organizar a Integração na Cia para os novos admitidos da Holding e Backoffice em parceria com o Analista de Gente e Gestão de Operações Hld;
  • Suportar as BP’s acompanhando os orçamentos ex-pessoal das áreas para viabilidade das ações;
  • Apoiar os BP’s nas entrevistas de desligamento online e análise de resultado dos cargos de base.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na área de Recursos Humanos perfil generalista.
  • Experiência com depto pessoal, movimentações, fechamento de ponto, controle de férias e acordos ao sindicato;
  • Conhecimento com pesquisa de clima, avaliação de desempenho, treinamentos, comunicação e integração;
  • Gostar de gente em primeiro lugar e visão longo prazo;
  • Conhecimento em SAP será considerado diferencial.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);

title: Cloud Platform Developer/Python
description:
Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior/Especialista
description:
Como Full Stack Developer Especialista na Sankhya, você faz parte do time de tecnologia e inovação, sua missão será usar suas habilidades para criar, implementar e manter soluções de ponta a ponta que atendam às necessidades de nossos usuários. Trabalhamos com foco em colaboração, governança, segurança e performance para entregar produtos impactantes e de alta qualidade.


Nosso #Tech Team é um dos times chaves que fazem acontecer dentro da Sankhya. Por causa desta galera cheia de criatividade e, com muita sede de desenvolvimento (literalmente), oferecemos cada dia mais um software completo interativo que guia nossos clientes com muita inovação e gestão inteligente!


Aqui na Sankhya buscamos novas formas de solução, que sejam menos complexas, autênticas e únicas. E com isso queremos pessoas que desejem crescer a cada dia junto com a empresa, ajudando a gente a construir cada vez mais um ambiente diverso e de crescimento acelerado.


Responsabilidades:

  • Participar ativamente de discussões de produto, colaborando com Product Managers e stakeholders para identificar necessidades e propor soluções;
  • Projetar e implementar interfaces web responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando React;
  • Desenvolver APIs e microserviços escaláveis e performáticos com Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI);
  • Integrar soluções de backend e frontend de maneira eficiente, garantindo usabilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploys e testes;
  • Implementar práticas de segurança, desempenho e monitoramento em aplicações web;
  • Validar e adaptar componentes de acordo com feedbacks dos usuários;
  • Documentar arquiteturas, fluxos e boas práticas para facilitar a colaboração e manutenção do código;
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para garantir a qualidade e inovação tecnológica.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento web com React e frameworks associados (e.g., Redux, Context API);
  • Proficiência em Python e frameworks de backend como Django, Flask ou FastAPI;
  • Experiência na criação e consumo de APIs RESTful e integração com bancos de dados;
  • Conhecimento em design responsivo e melhores práticas de UX/UI;
  • Familiaridade com Git Workflows, CI/CD e automação de processos;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu);
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem, especialmente AWS (S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, IAM);

title: Remote Angular Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Angular Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Develop, code, test, and debug application programs of varying degree of complexity.

- Code user interfaces with the latest frontend technologies

- Work with business users to develop and implement acceptance tests to ensure that product meets customer requirements and expectations.

- Ensure high performance of all systems developed.


Requirements:


- 4+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 2+ years of experience in Angular 2+.

- Experience in developing applications using Angular/Java technology stack.

- Solid experience with HTML, CSS, and writing cross-browser compatible code.

- Strong knowledge of AJAX and JavaScript Dom manipulation Techniques.

- Experience with MSSQL and/or PostgresSQL

- Experience with React is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Regulatory Specialist
description:
Job Overview:

Primary contact with investigative site(s) during site start-up activities and maintenance with responsibility for collection of the required investigator and essential documents for a study, to ensure EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority and any other local applications are made within the timelines agreed with project management and Site Readiness team and that documentation meets the specifications required by applicable regulations and sponsor. Proactively interacts with EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authorities to provide guidance regarding requirements. Maintain awareness of current regulatory standards related to submissions. Serve as local expert in project start-up activities for a particular country or region. Act as a ‘knowledge resource’ to mentor and train new hires and less-experienced department colleagues if suitable.


Summary of Responsibilities:



  • Maintain awareness of regulatory legislation, guidance, and practice in the assigned countries.
  • Coordinate, collect and organize data and information required by EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority including but not limited to the preparation of study documentation such as the country application form and cover letter for sponsor review as applicable.
  • Compile and prepare routine submission filed to IRB/IEC/Third body/Regulatory Authorities (e.g., INDs/CTAs) and liaise with them as applicable regarding submission/approval.
  • Liaise with internal and external vendors in the generation of Regulatory Authority submissions (as applicable).
  • Perform a review of final submission documents as applicable.
  • Ensure that all assigned start-up and maintenance activities are on track, in accordance with client expectations and budget and in compliance with applicable laws and guidelines, regulatory requirements, ICH/GCP, SOPs and quality standards
  • Prevent and escalate study issues appropriately and in a timely fashion.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management depending upon country and situational requirements with proper supervision (if applicable).
  • In Country specific tasks (Global):
  • Serve as primary contact for investigative sites and ensure documents required are collected in a timely manner.
  • Collect and track all the necessary documents required and perform a quality review, formatting, and compilation of the final documents for effective and compliant site activation and maintenance without supervision.
  • Ensure high quality documents are filed and systems are updated on an ongoing and timely basis, making Fortrea ready for an audit at any time.
  • Participate in team and project meetings as applicable.
  • When needed, assist in the strategy definition for Site Activation and provide accurate projections and timelines to study teams.
  • Review and customize country and site-specific patient informed consent forms for compliance with local requirements and protocol. Proactively resolve informed consent issues and other potential difficulties with study sites.
  • May support the negotiation of site contracts and budgets with sites, if applicable and track progress of contract and budget milestones/developments, intervening and escalating as appropriate.
  • Proactively identifying and escalating to Submission Leads any risk to meeting deliverables.
  • Notify the Submissions Lead of hours identified as Out-of-Scope or overburn.
  • Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) tasks (specific centralized role for EU):
  • Assist in the upload of submission documentation to, interacting with and monitoring of all notifications and alerts in CTIS to ensure all milestones and events for the trial are met within the timelines mandated.
  • Performs all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/College degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) AND 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
  • In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with a High School Diploma or equivalent AND a minimum of 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations will be considered.


Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical development or start-up/ regulatory process.
  • Working knowledge of ICH, RA, IRB/IEC, and other applicable regulations/guidelines; familiarity with investigator start-up documents and contract/budgets negotiation process; previous interaction with operational project teams and investigative sites.
  • Demonstrated understanding of research protocol requirements and proven ability to communicate them/educate others about them.


Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • General Office Environment.

title: Lead Python Engineer
description:
About Kyros

Kyros is a next-generation actuarial software platform, bringing together advanced modeling, interactive visualization, and automated workflows into a unified system. It helps actuarial teams move faster from analysis to delivery by combining powerful data processing with intuitive web applications.


Position Overview

We’re seeking a Senior Software Developer & Lead with deep expertise in Python and web application development who thrives on building momentum around technical initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on technical execution, software architecture leadership, and inspiring engineering excellence across unified teams.


Key Innovation:

This position leads our transition from siloed development teams (Plotly visualization, data modeling tools) into a unified software development organization focused on integrated product solutions. You’ll spend 60-70% of your time writing high-quality code, while also rallying the team around best practices, mentoring developers, and championing our long-term vision of continuous value delivery.


As both technical contributor and team leader, you’ll set the bar for code quality, help improve developer experience, and drive enthusiasm for our evolution toward CI/CD, test automation, and release-on-demand workflows. You’ll also participate in strategic quarterly planning sessions, providing technical feasibility input and capacity reality alongside our Actuarial Solutions Architect and Client Delivery Team Leads.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture (60–70%)

  • Lead by example – Write production-quality Python applications that demonstrate excellent coding standards, comprehensive testing, and clear documentation.
  • Set the technical bar through exemplary code reviews, thoughtful PR comments, and mentorship that elevates the entire team’s capabilities.
  • Software architecture collaboration – Work with existing software/systems architecture team members while developing capability to handle architectural decisions independently.
  • Modernize development practices – Guide team evolution toward CI/CD, automated testing, and Kanban-based throughput optimization.
  • Champion AI-assisted development – Model effective use of tools like Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development workflows.
  • Excellence in acceptance criteria – Drive development of comprehensive user acceptance criteria and ensure compliance with quality standards.


Team Leadership & Galvanizing (30–40%)

  • Unify development organization – Integrate separate Plotly and data modeling teams into cohesive group delivering integrated software solutions.
  • Champion technical initiatives and help the team get excited about new approaches, tools, and improvements.
  • Build consensus around architectural decisions and communicate the “why” behind technical choices to ensure buy-in.
  • Energize development processes – Lead daily standups, planning sessions, and retrospectives with enthusiasm that maintains team momentum.
  • Foster commitment and follow-through – Help team buy into quarterly commitments and establish accountability for delivering on promises made in retrospectives and planning sessions.
  • Mentor through collaboration – Provide “shoulder to shoulder” technical mentoring through pairing sessions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving rather than formal training programs.


Strategic Planning & Collaboration

  • Quarterly planning participation – Work with Actuarial Solutions Architect and Client Delivery Team Leads to assess technical feasibility, provide capacity estimates, and ensure realistic quarterly commitments.
  • Process ownership evolution – Implement agile and software disciplines with enterprise coaching support initially, then take increasing ownership of process improvements and team excellence initiatives.
  • Kanban and throughput optimization – Work with cycle time, throughput, and other Kanban-based KPIs to optimize team performance.
  • Skills gap identification – Assess team capabilities and coordinate development plans for junior developers eager to grow.


Technical Requirements

  • 8+ years professional software development experience with strong Python expertise.
  • 2+ years of leading experience
  • Experience with Azure Cloud
  • Web application development using frameworks like Flask, Djan, or FastAPI.
  • Database proficiency – SQL databases, query optimization, and data architecture decisions.
  • Testing discipline – Unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing practices including BDD and TDD methodologies.


Nice to have :

  • Data manipulation and scaling – Experience with large datasets, performance optimization, and data processing pipelines using pandas, numpy, and potentially pyspark.
  • CI/CD pipeline automation – Advanced automation and deployment optimization experience.
  • Machine Learning libraries – Experience with torch, pytorch, pytorch lightning, or similar ML frameworks (preferred but not required).
  • Big data processing – Experience with Databricks, Spark, or similar distributed data processing platforms


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Turing is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer, Integrated Marketing to produce visually compelling designs across diverse marketing channels. This role focuses on creating on-brand advertising campaigns, presentation templates, brand guidelines, digital assets, and integrated marketing initiatives.

Collaborating closely with marketing designers embedded across business units, you’ll maintain and evolve Turing’s visual identity, leveraging the latest creative tools and staying ahead of design trends to deliver exceptional brand experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Production: Create compelling graphics and creative assets for integrated marketing initiatives including advertising campaigns, social media, email, presentations, digital content, and events.
  • Brand Consistency: Support and evolve Turing’s visual design system and brand guidelines, maintaining templates, design libraries, and visual standards across internal and external communications.
  • Collaboration and Alignment: Partner closely with embedded marketing designers, copywriters, and internal stakeholders to ensure cohesive visual storytelling and consistent brand execution across teams.
  • Presentation and Asset Development: Develop polished, professional, end-to-end presentation templates that minimize the need for end-user customization (Google Slides, PowerPoint); and creation of other marketing collateral that clearly communicate brand messaging and positioning.
  • Market and Trend Awareness: Stay current with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to continuously improve creative quality, innovation, and execution speed.


Requirements

  • 9+ years of graphic design experience, preferably in technology, AI, SaaS, or similar industries.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and Canva
  • Strong working knowledge of presentation tools (Google Slides and PowerPoint). Deep understanding of master slides, theme building, and layout systems in both platforms.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools for design (e.g., Midjourney, Runway, Adobe Firefly) to enhance creative output and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and integrated marketing principles.
  • Demonstrated experience with design systems, brand guidelines, and visual identity management across diverse channels.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and communication skills, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive learner comfortable working remotely in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience designing client-facing presentations, such as pitch decks and sales materials, with a focus on clear visual storytelling, data visualization, and adherence to brand standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing within AI, tech, or rapidly scaling startup environments.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics, video editing software (After Effects, Premiere Pro), or AI-driven motion tools.
  • Portfolio showcasing integrated marketing campaigns, presentation materials (powerpoint and/or google slides), and consistent brand execution across channels.
  • Familiarity with global and multi-audience brand challenges.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Lead Site Reliability Engineer

Localização(ões): São Paulo

Arranjo de trabalho: Híbrido

Reporta-se a: Gerente Sênior de Infraestrutura de TI


O time que você fará parte

O time é responsável por garantir a saúde, estabilidade e observabilidade dos sistemas, atuando de forma proativa para prevenir falhas e responder rapidamente a incidentes.


A oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para liderar as iniciativas de observabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas em nossa infraestrutura tecnológica. Como Líder de Observabilidade e SRE, você será responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas críticos sejam resilientes, escaláveis e monitoráveis de forma proativa.

Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem esteja procurando novos desafios numa empresa multinacional líder global no seu setor, que esta investindo em modernizar as suas soluçoes digitais e nas suas operacoes de TI.

Como você nos ajudará a construir um futuro confiante (principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar a arquitetura de observabilidade no Brasil em coordenação com as equipes regionais e globais.
  • Implementar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento, rastreamento distribuído e análise de logs, com foco em Elastic.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de SRE, DevOps e desenvolvimento para garantir que os sistemas sejam projetados com observabilidade desde o início.
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar métricas e indicadores-chave (SLIs, SLOs, SLAs) para os sistemas e serviços da empresa.
  • Conduzir análises de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria tanto nos sistemas e serviços da empresa quanto na arquitetura de observabilidade.
  • Promover a cultura de “monitoramento como código” e automação de alertas.
  • Liderar iniciativas de capacitação interna sobre boas práticas de observabilidade.
  • Liderar as equipes de monitoração e SREs, promovendo boas práticas de confiabilidade, observabilidade e automação.
  • Supervisionar a resposta a incidentes críticos e apoiar nas análises de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação técnica e planos de resposta a incidentes (Knowledge Base).

O que você precisa para ter sucesso (qualificações necessárias)

  • Experiência em ferramentas de observabilidade, busca, análise e visualização dos dados;
  • Ter liderado equipes e iniciativas de SRE;
  • Inglês avançado/Fluente;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Azure Cloud.

O que pode te dar uma vantagem (habilidade adicionais)

  • Conhecer da ferramenta Elastic;
  • Espanhol avançado.

O que oferecemos?

  • Salário competitivo;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche/babá

Sobre a MetLife

Reconhecida na lista da revista Fortune das "Empresas Mais Admiradas do Mundo" de 2024, bem como na lista Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For ® de 2025, a MetLife, por meio de suas subsidiárias e afiliadas, é uma das principais empresas de serviços financeiros do mundo; fornecendo seguros, anuidades, benefícios para funcionários e gestão de ativos para clientes individuais e institucionais. Com operações em mais de 40 mercados, ocupamos posições de liderança nos Estados Unidos, na América Latina, na Ásia, na Europa e no Oriente Médio. Nosso propósito é simples: ajudar nossos colegas, clientes, comunidades e o mundo em geral a criar um futuro mais confiante. Unidos por um propósito e guiados pela empatia, somos

inspirados a transformar o próximo século em serviços financeiros. Na MetLife, é #AllTogetherPossible. Junte-se a nós!

A MetLife orgulha-se de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais, empenhado em atrair, reter e maximizar o desempenho de uma força de trabalho diversificada e inclusiva. title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
O Desafio


Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em soluções escaláveis, com conhecimento consolidado em LLMs e IA. Você será fundamental para projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de IA de ponta, focados em Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN) para dados clínicos complexos.


Esperamos que você traga uma visão estratégica sobre IA e MLOps, ajudando a moldar a arquitetura dos nossos produtos e expandir nossos horizontes tecnológicos.


Em um ambiente colaborativo e de equipe enxuta, valorizamos a iniciativa e protagonismo : buscamos pessoas que se sintam confortáveis propondo, liderando e implementando soluções complexas, com um olhar atento à performance, escalabilidade e ética da IA.


Responsabilidades


Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos de IA/LLMs: desde a pesquisa e prototipagem até a implementação em produção e monitoramento contínuo.


Projetar e construir arquiteturas de software escaláveis para hospedar e gerenciar LLMs e outros modelos de IA.


Implementar e otimizar pipelines de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) para garantir a entrega contínua, deployment e monitoramento de modelos.


Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para LLMs, visando a extração precisa de informações clínicas e a geração de respostas contextuais.


Escrever códigos de forma limpa, escalável, performática e testável, aplicando os melhores padrões de engenharia de software.


Realizar revisões de código de pares, fornecendo feedback construtivo e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Analisar requerimentos de negócio e produto, transformando-os em especificações técnicas e priorizando tarefas de alto impacto.


Atuar como mentor(a) técnico(a) para desenvolvedores e engenheiros de IA mais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e promovendo o crescimento da equipe.


Colaborar ativamente com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas de domínio (médicos) para garantir a relevância e eficácia das soluções de IA.


Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas pesquisas e avanços em IA, PLN e LLMs, e avaliar a aplicação de novas tecnologias.


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software ou IA Sênior, com foco em sistemas de IA/ML em produção.


  • Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência com frameworks de ML/DL (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).


  • Conhecimento consolidado e experiência prática com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo técnicas (e.g., Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, RAG) e ferramentas (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).


  • Experiência robusta no desenvolvimento e implantação de pipelines de MLOps e em plataformas de nuvem (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML).


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos (Docker, Kubernetes).


  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.


  • Capacidade de escrever e implementar rotinas de testes abrangentes para código e modelos de IA.


  • Habilidade de liderança técnica para projetos, decisões arquiteturais e mentoria de equipes.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Conhecimentos Desejáveis


  • Fluência em inglês.


  • Experiência com C# e .NET (para integração).


  • Conhecimento de frameworks front-end (Angular, React) para interfaces de IA.


  • Experiência específica com dados de saúde (HL7, FHIR) ou no setor de healthtech.


  • Otimização de modelos para inferência em larga escala (e.g., com GPUs).


  • Conhecimento em ética em IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e viés em modelos.


Se você quer atuar no cruzamento entre tecnologia de ponta, IA, dados complexos e saúde - e gosta de resolver problemas que fazem a diferença na vida de milhares, impulsionando a próxima geração da medicina - se candidate e venha conversar conosco!

Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em soluções escaláveis, com conhecimento consolidado em LLMs e IA. Você será fundamental para projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de IA de ponta, focados em Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN) para dados clínicos complexos.


Esperamos que você traga uma visão estratégica sobre IA e MLOps, ajudando a moldar a arquitetura dos nossos produtos e expandir nossos horizontes tecnológicos.


Em um ambiente colaborativo e de equipe enxuta, valorizamos a iniciativa e protagonismo : buscamos pessoas que se sintam confortáveis propondo, liderando e implementando soluções complexas, com um olhar atento à performance, escalabilidade e ética da IA.


Responsabilidades


Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos de IA/LLMs: desde a pesquisa e prototipagem até a implementação em produção e monitoramento contínuo.


Projetar e construir arquiteturas de software escaláveis para hospedar e gerenciar LLMs e outros modelos de IA.


Implementar e otimizar pipelines de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) para garantir a entrega contínua, deployment e monitoramento de modelos.


Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para LLMs, visando a extração precisa de informações clínicas e a geração de respostas contextuais.


Escrever códigos de forma limpa, escalável, performática e testável, aplicando os melhores padrões de engenharia de software.


Realizar revisões de código de pares, fornecendo feedback construtivo e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Analisar requerimentos de negócio e produto, transformando-os em especificações técnicas e priorizando tarefas de alto impacto.


Atuar como mentor(a) técnico(a) para desenvolvedores e engenheiros de IA mais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e promovendo o crescimento da equipe.


Colaborar ativamente com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas de domínio (médicos) para garantir a relevância e eficácia das soluções de IA.


Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas pesquisas e avanços em IA, PLN e LLMs, e avaliar a aplicação de novas tecnologias.


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software ou IA Sênior, com foco em sistemas de IA/ML em produção.


  • Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência com frameworks de ML/DL (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).


  • Conhecimento consolidado e experiência prática com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo técnicas (e.g., Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, RAG) e ferramentas (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).


  • Experiência robusta no desenvolvimento e implantação de pipelines de MLOps e em plataformas de nuvem (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML).


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos (Docker, Kubernetes).


  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.


  • Capacidade de escrever e implementar rotinas de testes abrangentes para código e modelos de IA.


  • Habilidade de liderança técnica para projetos, decisões arquiteturais e mentoria de equipes.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Conhecimentos Desejáveis


  • Fluência em inglês.


  • Experiência com C# e .NET (para integração).


  • Conhecimento de frameworks front-end (Angular, React) para interfaces de IA.


  • Experiência específica com dados de saúde (HL7, FHIR) ou no setor de healthtech.


  • Otimização de modelos para inferência em larga escala (e.g., com GPUs).


  • Conhecimento em ética em IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e viés em modelos.


Se você quer atuar no cruzamento entre tecnologia de ponta, IA, dados complexos e saúde - e gosta de resolver problemas que fazem a diferença na vida de milhares, impulsionando a próxima geração da medicina - se candidate e venha conversar conosco!

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer for an Online Job Site
description:
OysterLink is the newest and fastest growing restaurant & hospitality job site . The site just launched recently and is generating over 300,000 monthly visitors organically.


We are seeking a Video Editor & Graphic Designer with creative thinking, hands-on expertise and excellent English communication with proven expertise in:

  • Creating graphics for articles, social media, banners and other digital assets
  • Creating and editing videos for use on social media and YouTube
  • Creating and delivering motion graphics for various media
  • Editing video footage and adding effects/elements to enhance motion graphics
  • Working closely with the marketing team


The GOALS for this position is to:

  • Produce high-quality graphics and videos that align with OysterLink’s brand styleguide and drive engagement.
  • Support marketing campaigns by delivering creative assets on time.
  • Innovate and improve content by introducing new designs and video trends.


Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of visual design and video editing experience, as well as a strong portfolio of sample projects to share
  • Knowledge of layouts, graphic fundamentals, typography, video editing
  • Proven experience creating digital graphics for social media, articles, banners, and marketing campaigns
  • Expertise in video editing for social media and YouTube, including pacing, storytelling, and sound synchronization
  • Must have the ability to storyboard or translate ideas to team members
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro) or equivalent tools
  • Strong written and spoken English skills



OysterLink offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND profit sharing .


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position. We do require team members who can work up until 3pm EST.


What we offer at OysterLink:

  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Job stability and growth
  • Profit Sharing
  • Shares in the company to receive earn out when company is sold
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with our Recruiter
  • Have an interview with Hiring Manager
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend - React & Next.js
description:
Resumo: Procuramos um(a) desenvolvedor(a) frontend para construir interfaces rápidas, acessíveis e escaláveis usando React e Next.js (App Router). Você colaborará com Design/Produto e Backend para entregar experiências diferenciadas em web.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces com React e Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR).
  • Implementar componentes reutilizáveis e acessíveis (WCAG) alinhados a um Design System .
  • Otimizar performance (Core Web Vitals) e web analytics .
  • Integrar com APIs REST/GraphQL e gerenciar estado (React Query/Zustand/Context).
  • Escrever testes (unitários e e2e) e participar de code reviews/CI-CD.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React , Next.js e TypeScript .
  • Domínio de HTML5/CSS3 (preferível Tailwind ou CSS-in-JS).
  • Conhecimento de SSR/SSG/ISR , roteamento, data fetching e otimização de imagens no Next.js.
  • Boas práticas de Git , testes (Jest/RTL/Playwright) e acessibilidade .
  • Noções de performance (profiling, bundle splitting)

title: Software Engineer Vue/Nuxt (Req English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is an innovative technology company specializing in developing cutting-edge software solutions for diverse industries. Our team thrives in a collaborative and dynamic environment, where creativity meets technical expertise to bring exceptional products to life. We focus on utilizing the latest technologies, and our projects involve building scalable applications using modern frameworks.
Position Overview,
We’re looking for a Frontend Developer to help build sleek, high-impact sites for rapidly growing enterprises. The main technology is Vue/Nuxt 3, leveraging headless CMSs and hosted on Vercel.
You’ll own key parts of the frontend and be responsible for integrating third-party services. If you're a Vue/Nuxt expert who enjoys working with modern tools and building clean, performant websites while maintaning a clean documentation - this is for you.
Key Responsibilities:
Build and maintain modular, reusable components in Nuxt 3
- Working and integrating external APIs
- Help evaluate and integrate documentation
- Optimize performance, SEO, and accessibility across all pages
- Collaborate with designers, marketers, and product stakeholders
- Deploy, test, and maintain apps on Vercel
Tech Stack:
- Nuxt 3 (Vue 3 + Composition API + TypeScript)
- Contentful (Headless CMS),Vercel (Hosting & CI/CD)
- Tools: Git, Figma (for design handoff), and Jira

Key Responsibilities:
Build and maintain modular, reusable components in Nuxt 3
- Working and integrating external APIs
- Help evaluate and integrate documentation
- Optimize performance, SEO, and accessibility across all pages
- Collaborate with designers, marketers, and product stakeholders
- Deploy, test, and maintain apps on Vercel
Tech Stack:
- Nuxt 3 (Vue 3 + Composition API + TypeScript)
- Contentful (Headless CMS),Vercel (Hosting & CI/CD)
- Tools: Git, Figma (for design handoff), and Jira

description:

  • 6 a 10 anos de experiência como desenvolvedor;
  • 4 anos de experiência profissional com Laravel + PHP;

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A inovaVoip é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções de comunicação em nuvem e telefonia VoIP. Nosso foco é oferecer plataformas estáveis, seguras e escaláveis, desenvolvidas com tecnologias modernas como React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase e Docker .

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar na melhoria e otimização de um sistema já existente , preparando-o para produção e escalabilidade . Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), com visão técnica, responsabilidade e desejo de crescimento.

Responsabilidades
  • Revisar, higienizar e otimizar o código existente, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir erros, gargalos e falhas de lógica.
  • Aprimorar performance e segurança das principais páginas e fluxos do sistema.
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento de permissões, limites e planos de uso.
  • Preparar o ambiente de execução e deployment utilizando Docker e Docker Compose .
  • Implementar melhorias em integrações Realtime (Supabase, Redis, WebRTC).
  • Colaborar com revisões técnicas e propor soluções estruturadas.
  • Contribuir com documentação e padronização de código.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência com React (19.x) e Next.js (15.x) .
  • Domínio em TypeScript (5.x) e boas práticas de tipagem.
  • Experiência com Node.js (20.x) e Express.js .
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL / Supabase .
  • Experiência com Redis para cache e gerenciamento de sessões.
  • Habilidade em Docker / Docker Compose .
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub .
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com WebRTC e Asterisk (VoIP) .
  • Vivência com Supabase Realtime ou Sockets .
  • Conhecimento em TailwindCSS e Radix UI .
  • Familiaridade com Clean Code , SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e CI/CD .
Perfil Ideal

Buscamos um(a) profissional com senso de responsabilidade, organização e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.

Valorizamos pessoas proativas, com iniciativa e comprometimento em entregar resultados de qualidade, que queiram crescer junto com o projeto e influenciar sua evolução técnica .

Modelo de Trabalho
  • 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível (foco em entregas)
  • Contratação PJ / Freelancer
  • Início imediato
Faixa de Remuneração

R$ 6.000 a R$ 10.000 (PJ / mês)

A faixa pode variar conforme experiência e nível técnico.

O que oferecemos
  • Liberdade técnica para propor melhorias e novas soluções.
  • Participação direta em decisões de arquitetura.
  • Acompanhamento técnico e feedback contínuo.
  • Cultura de colaboração e comunicação transparente.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em produto real.

Interessados devem enviar portfólio, GitHub ou LinkedIn com exemplos de projetos utilizando React , Next.js , Node.js , Supabase e Docker .

Assistente Comercial – Seguros (Presencial)


Local: Setor Comercial Sul – Asa Sul, Brasília/DF

Horário: 8h às 18h (seg. a sex.) • Regime: CLT


Sobre a vaga


Procuramos um(a) Assistente Comercial de Seguros para atuar no atendimento e suporte às vendas, garantindo agilidade nas cotações, propostas e emissão de apólices.



Responsabilidades


Atender clientes (telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp).

Realizar cotações, montagem de propostas, emissão de apólices/endossos e acompanhamento de renovações.

Manter relacionamento com seguradoras para condições comerciais e alçadas.

Organizar documentação, prazos e pendências dos clientes.

Registrar oportunidades e etapas no CRM, mantendo dados atualizados.

Apoiar o pós-venda (acompanhamento de sinistros junto ao setor responsável).

Cumprir metas de vendas e qualidade.



Requisitos


Ensino Médio completo (desejável técnico/graduação em Seguros, Administração ou áreas afins).

Experiência em vendas de seguros e rotinas de corretora (propostas, apólices, relacionamento com seguradoras).

Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Outlook).

Boa comunicação, organização e foco em resultados.

Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial no SCS – Asa Sul.



Remuneração e benefícios


Salário: R$ 1.600,00 (CLT).

Comissões acima da média + PLR semestral.

VR: R$ 730,00 (em dinheiro).

VT.

Plano de saúde (100% custeado pela empresa) + plano odontológico + seguro de vida.

Presencial • SCS – Asa Sul • Segunda a sexta, 8h às 18h.

title: Cientista de Dados SR - Supply Chain
description:
Oportunidade | Cientista de Dados SR - Supply Chain

Modelo de atuação: 100% Remoto


Responsabilidades

Conduzir análises quantitativas e estatísticas aplicadas ao supply chain.

Desenvolver modelos preditivos e algoritmos de otimização para logística, inventário, planejamento de demanda etc.

Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de negócio para transformar desafios em soluções baseadas em dados.

Documentar metodologias e resultados de forma clara e estruturada.

Garantir qualidade e integridade dos dados usados nas análises.


✅ Requisitos

Formação em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência com ciência de dados aplicada a supply chain (imprescindível).

Domínio em Python, SQL e bibliotecas (Pandas, Scikit-learn, NumPy).

Experiência em modelagem de dados, estatística, machine learning e algoritmos de otimização.

Conhecimento sólido dos processos de supply chain (mandatório).


⭐ Desejáveis

Vivência em GCP, AWS e projetos de Recomendação de Produtos.

Bibliotecas de otimização (Pyomo, PuLP).

Séries temporais e previsão de demanda (Prophet).

Pós-graduação ou MBA.
